description: Implement the Android integration layer of the experimental app: the manifest (mediaPlayback foreground service type + matching permission + SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW + own NotificationListenerService, NO BootReceiver/autostart/Cloud/INTERNET), the mediaPlayback foreground service, the AudioFocusPort (AudioManager + AudioFocusRequest AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK), the MediaControlPort + MediaSession discovery (own notification-listener), the OverlayVideoPort (fullscreen TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY playing a LOCAL mp4), a LocalAudioPort (short local SceneVibe test audio), and the TV diagnostic Activity with the five actions and bounded diagnostics display. All of this wires the FEAT-002 core to real Android APIs behind the port interfaces. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Complete mediaexperiment/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Declare uses-feature leanback required=true and touchscreen required=false. Declare permissions: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK (targetSdk 35 requires the typed permission). Do NOT declare INTERNET, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, or any Cloud/boot permission. application: allowBackup=false, Theme.Material.NoActionBar, label @string/app_name, its own icon/banner.

Declare the diagnostic Activity (e.g. .MediaExperimentActivity) exported=true with a LEANBACK_LAUNCHER intent-filter so it is the TV launcher entry for the experimental app (distinct from :app's MainActivity).

Declare the foreground service (e.g. .InterludeService) exported=false with android:foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback". In onCreate create its OWN notification channel (distinct channel id, e.g. 'media_interlude_poc') and call startForeground with FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK. Mirror OverlayService lifecycle (START_STICKY, stopSelf on overlay-permission loss) but share NO code/prefs with :app.

Declare the module's OWN NotificationListenerService (e.g. .ExperimentMediaAccessService) with BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE permission and the NotificationListenerService intent-filter, in the experimental package. Add a NotificationAccess-equivalent helper in the module that checks Settings.Secure 'enabled_notification_listeners' against THIS module's ComponentName (do not import :app's NotificationAccess).

Implement MediaSession discovery in the module (mirroring MediaSessionProbe, not importing it): MediaSessionManager.getActiveSessions(ownListenerComponent), select the relevant active controller, read PlaybackState (state, actions) and MediaMetadata (mediaId/title/subtitle/duration) into the FEAT-002 PlaybackSnapshot value object. Record available PlaybackState actions (e.g. ACTION_PAUSE/ACTION_PLAY presence) into Diagnostics. This is the SCAN MEDIA SESSION action.

Implement MediaControlPort against the discovered MediaController: pause() calls controller.getTransportControls().pause(); play() calls controller.getTransportControls().play(). After pause(), the core waits (bounded) for an observed PlaybackState STATE_PAUSED via continued sampling; after play(), waits (bounded) for STATE_PLAYING. Never treat the dispatch as confirmation.

Implement AudioFocusPort using AudioManager + AudioFocusRequest.Builder(AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK) with explicit AudioAttributes appropriate for short spoken audio (USAGE_ASSISTANCE_SONIFICATION or USAGE_MEDIA/USAGE_ASSISTANT with CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH — choose and justify a short-spoken-audio-appropriate pair). requestTransientMayDuck returns GRANTED only on AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED; abandon() calls abandonAudioFocusRequest. Do NOT programmatically change Prime/stream volume anywhere.

Implement LocalAudioPort: play a SHORT local SceneVibe test audio asset (place a small generated/royalty-free short clip at mediaexperiment/src/main/res/raw/ or assets/) via MediaPlayer. Only play after AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED; on finish, abandon focus. If focus not granted, DO NOT play.

Implement OverlayVideoPort: a fullscreen TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY window (MATCH_PARENT x MATCH_PARENT) via WindowManager (mirror SceneRenderer's window setup and Settings.canDrawOverlays gate and removeViewImmediate cleanup) hosting a TextureView (or VideoView) + MediaPlayer that plays a LOCAL short mp4 bundled at mediaexperiment/src/main/assets/ (NO network streaming). On completion fire VIDEO_COMPLETED; on MediaPlayer error fire VIDEO_ERROR. Document in code the chosen rendering mechanism. Provide a small local mp4 asset (a few seconds, tiny resolution) in the module.

Wire the InterludeService / Activity to drive the FEAT-002 InterludeStateMachine with these ports on the main thread. Implement EMERGENCY RESTORE / STOP: stop local audio/video, abandon audio focus, remove every experimental overlay, clear POC state; only send PLAY if the SafeResumeGuard proves this POC owns the confirmed pause.

Build the TV diagnostic Activity (programmatic UI like MainActivity): a title, a scrollable bounded diagnostics area, and five D-pad-focusable buttons: SCAN MEDIA SESSION, TEST AUDIO DUCK, TEST PAUSE, TEST FULL INTERLUDE, EMERGENCY RESTORE / STOP. Also provide buttons to open overlay-permission settings and notification-access settings (reuse MainActivity's intent patterns). The diagnostics area shows ONLY the bounded fields from FEAT-002 Diagnostics (selected package, PlaybackState, actions, mediaId presence, focus result, pause sent/confirmed/timeout, overlay attached, video started/completed/error, play sent, resume confirmed/timeout). No content text or credentials.

Enforce the gating in the integrated flow: TEST FULL INTERLUDE must require a POC-issued pause that is CONFIRMED (observed STATE_PAUSED) before attaching the overlay; if pause is not confirmed within timeout, report UNSUPPORTED/NOT CONFIRMED and do NOT attach the overlay or play video. Before PLAY at the end, re-run the SafeResumeGuard against the current snapshot.

Confirm NO forbidden mechanisms are present anywhere in the module: no AccessibilityService, no injected key/remote events, no Instrumentation/adb input calls, no coordinate injection, no reading of Prime's view hierarchy. MediaSession transport only.

Run `:mediaexperiment:assembleDebug` to confirm the integrated module compiles. Commit (e.g. 'feat(poc): add mediaPlayback FGS, audio-duck, MediaSession pause/play, fullscreen overlay video, and TV diagnostic UI'). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: mediaexperiment manifest declares foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback" and uses-permission FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK and SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, and does NOT declare INTERNET, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, any BootReceiver, or any Cloud component.
The module has its OWN NotificationListenerService and notification-access check pointing at its own ComponentName; it does not reference :app classes.

AudioFocusPort requests AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK with explicit AudioAttributes and only reports granted on AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED; local audio plays ONLY when granted; no code changes stream volume.

MediaControlPort issues pause()/play() only via MediaController transport controls; the integrated flow treats only an observed STATE_PAUSED/STATE_PLAYING as confirmation and reports UNSUPPORTED/NOT CONFIRMED on timeout.
OverlayVideoPort uses a fullscreen TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY playing a bundled LOCAL mp4 (no network), gated on Settings.canDrawOverlays, and is only attached after a CONFIRMED POC pause.
The TV Activity exposes exactly the five actions (SCAN MEDIA SESSION, TEST AUDIO DUCK, TEST PAUSE, TEST FULL INTERLUDE, EMERGENCY RESTORE / STOP) and displays only the bounded diagnostics fields.
No AccessibilityService, no input injection, no UI scraping anywhere in the module.
verification: Run `:mediaexperiment:assembleDebug --console=plain` and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL with the full integration present.

Grep the module for forbidden APIs and confirm none appear: `AccessibilityService`, `dispatchKeyEvent` injection, `Instrumentation`, `sendKeyEvent`, `setStreamVolume`, `adb`. Confirm `getActiveSessions`, `AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK`, `TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY`, `foregroundServiceType` mediaPlayback, and `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK` are present.
Confirm the manifest does NOT contain INTERNET / RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED / any receiver, and the applicationId remains com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment.
findings: Implemented the full Android integration layer behind the FEAT-002 ports, wired on the main thread. New files under mediaexperiment/src/main/java/.../mediaexperiment/: ExperimentMediaAccessService (own NotificationListenerService), ExperimentNotificationAccess (own enabled_notification_listeners check against this module's ComponentName), MediaSessionScanner (getActiveSessions discovery + PlaybackState action flags + PlaybackSnapshot/SessionTarget conversion; MediaSession transport only), AndroidAudioFocusPort (AudioFocusRequest AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK with USAGE_ASSISTANT/CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH; granted only on AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED; no setStreamVolume anywhere), AndroidLocalAudioPort (plays res/raw/scenevibe_cue.m4a via MediaPlayer only after focus granted), AndroidMediaControlPort (controller.getTransportControls().pause()/play() only), AndroidOverlayVideoPort (fullscreen TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY + TextureView + MediaPlayer playing bundled assets/interlude.mp4; interactive so NOT FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE; canDrawOverlays gated; removeViewImmediate cleanup; fires onVideoCompleted/onVideoError), ElapsedRealtimeClock, InterludeService (mediaPlayback FGS, distinct channel 'media_interlude_poc', START_STICKY, stopSelf on overlay-permission loss, 1s sampler driving observe()/onTick(), the five actions, emergency stop), MediaExperimentActivity (LEANBACK_LAUNCHER TV D-pad UI with exactly five buttons SCAN MEDIA SESSION / TEST AUDIO DUCK / TEST PAUSE / TEST FULL INTERLUDE / EMERGENCY RESTORE / STOP, plus overlay- and notification-access settings buttons, bounded diagnostics display only). Assets generated locally with a bundled ffmpeg (imageio-ffmpeg) at build time (no runtime network): interlude.mp4 (~29KB, 320x180 H.264 baseline, 3s) and scenevibe_cue.m4a (~11KB, 1.2s). Manifest declares foregroundServiceType=mediaPlayback + FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK + SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW + FOREGROUND_SERVICE; NO INTERNET/RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED/receiver/Cloud. Lint fix: startForeground(id,notification,type) is API 29+, so guarded with Build.VERSION check and 2-arg fallback for minSdk 26-28. Verification: :mediaexperiment:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL; :mediaexperiment:testDebugUnitTest and :mediaexperiment:lintDebug green (MissingLeanbackLauncher gone); :app:assembleDebug still green; git diff --name-only -- app/ empty. Debug APK SHA-256 48fd2e4ce41c8e92acd288bc3379b321d6dd55af0be3817d684837f27a306462 (non-reproducible; informational). Real audio ducking / Prime pause / on-Sony interlude remain NOT YET TESTED (no device/emulator); never claimed PASS.
